title: Light-like Wilson loops and the $\bar{Q}$-equation
summary: In recent work we began a study of the correlators of multiple light-like Wilson loops in $\mathcal{N}=4$ super Yang-Mills theory, focussing primarily on tree-level calculations and, beyond tree-level, to the Abelian theory. Here we calculate $O(g^2)$ correlators of multiple light-like Wilson loops in the $SU(N)$ theory. We use the chiral box expansion and a study of the leading singularities of the loop integrand to arrive at integrated expressions for these objects.
